Defect → fix → tests (each new behaviour has a test that fails if the

| Defect | Fix | Tests |
|---|---|---|
| NEW-8 reviewer detail 500 over PG | `_row()` in `db/src/db/intake.py` serialises `uuid.UUID` (and datetimes/lists generically) | `tests/api/test_curation_intake.py` detail over memory; `tests/db/test_intake_pg.py` detail route over the real PG store (Docker) |
| NEW-15 gate ignores owner/staffed | `intake_operational()` requires `[intake].operational` AND `SIG_INTAKE_OPERATIONAL=1` AND non-empty `owner` AND `staffed=true` | parametrised `test_intake_operational_env_gate` over owner/staffed/flag combinations; `ops/config.toml` keeps `operational=false` |
| NEW-30 demo tokens with a DSN | `create_curation_app` calls `load_tier_token_store(allow_demo_fallback=False)` whenever a DSN is set (`dsn` arg or an intake-store DSN string); `serve-curation` passes `dsn` through | demo bearer → 401 with `dsn=` set (unit); PG test builds the curation app with `intake_store=<dsn>` and asserts demo tokens refused |
| NEW-16 limiter keys + refusals charged | `_client_host` honours `trusted_proxy_hops` (count from the right of `X-Forwarded-For`; `ops/config.toml [intake].trusted_proxy_hops = 0` default → direct peer); `try_accept` moved after token check + `normalize_report` + dedupe, so only an accepted new submission is charged | spoofed XFF ignored at hops=0; hop-counted key at hops>0; a 422 refusal then enough valid submissions in one burst |
| NEW-17 reporter sees resolved-only | new sqitch change `intake_reporter_outcome` extends `intake.report_public` (additive columns: `outcome`, `correction_ref`, `publication_id`, `tombstone`); `public_status` selects them; `/intake/v1/status` emits `outcome`, `response`, `correction_ref`, `publication_id`, `tombstone`, `result_url` | memory + PG status after approve/publish show outcome/response/link; forbidden-key set still disjoint |
| NEW-18 approved proposal unapplicable | `intake_receiver.toml` gains `[proposal.object_value]` (the per-object_type required/optional value columns — the single table of record); `validate_proposal` requires `object_type` for correct/annotate and validates `required ⊆ present ⊆ required∪optional` at proposal time; `intake_apply` consumes the same table and refuses `object_type_mismatch` | ill-shaped value refused at `disposition_proposed` (422 route + unit); `test_object_type_mismatch_refused` over the PG bridge |
| NEW-19 form: category, viewport, ids | `_page` gains viewport meta; the category `<select>` gets a disabled placeholder (`required` forces a real choice); form copy drops the "anonymous/no email" promise (e-mail-only Round 11); `GET /intake/new` accepts `publication_id`/`record_key`/`claim_ids` deep-link prefill (contract-shaped only); `release_pages.record_page` emits a "Report this record" deep link — `/dispute/?<context>` while dark, `/intake/new?…` only when a build sets `SIG_INTAKE_DEEPLINK=1` | form HTML assertions (viewport, placeholder, no `<script>`); prefill test; `test_record_page_report_this_deep_link` asserts `/dispute/` href while dark + `/intake/new` only under the flag |

Non-goals honoured: `/dispute/` and corrections-page text are P34.17;

## Self-review + gap analysis vs spec

Walked the full diff against `docs/tickets/245_…` line-by-line:

  test covers each single-missing condition. ✓
- NEW-30: `dsn_backed` detection covers `dsn` arg, DSN-string intake_store,
  and pre-built PG store objects; `without_demo_tokens()` strips demo keys
  even from an injected store. ✓
- NEW-16: `trusted_proxy_hops` (committed `[intake].trusted_proxy_hops=0`,
  clamped 0–8) slices the Forwarded/XFF chain right-to-left; limiter moved
  after token check + `normalize_report` + idempotency so refusals are

  reads only the projection; `result_url` prefers `/r/<pub>/` then
  `/corrections/`; nothing before `published`. ✓
- NEW-18: `[proposal.object_value]` is the single table of record;
  proposal-time `required ⊆ present ⊆ required∪optional`; apply re-checks
  declared-vs-resolved → `object_type_mismatch`. ✓
- NEW-19: placeholder + viewport + contract-shaped prefill; the record-page

- Receiver stays dark: `ops/config.toml [intake]` still reads

- Restricted-column boundary: the projection's new columns derive only from
